song.cwHasNoJustification: You must add a reason for wanting to add a content warning onto the page, e.g. violent content, sexual content, etc.
song.genAiHasNoUsageAttribution: You must specify which part of the song/video uses Generative AI, e.g. illustration, lyrics.
song.genAiHasNoSource: You must add a source/explanation attributing to the verified/suspected usage of Generative AI.
song.noTitle: You haven't entered a song title.
song.noDate: You haven't entered the date of publication.
song.noSingerInMarkup: You need to list at least one singer in markup, e.g. [[Kagamine Rin]].
song.noProducer: You haven't listed any producers. For well-known producers, it is recommended that the producer's name is listed in markup, e.g. [[wowaka]], before you generate the song page.
song.noProducerInMarkup: If the producer already has a page on VOCALOID Lyrics wiki, then you should add the name of that producer in markup, e.g. "[[wowaka]] (music)" or "[[nagimiso]] (illustration)". Clicking the "Autoload Categories" button again in this case will automatically generate the category for that producer.
song.noPlayLink: No music videos or play links are detected. Please check the "Song is publically unavailable" if official releases are no longer available, or check the "Song is an album-only release" option if the song is released on albums only
song.noViewCount: Did you forget to add the view counts?
song.bilibiliUsesAvid: The Vocaloid Lyrics Wiki recommends attaching Bilibili links in the new BVid format rather than the old avid format.
song.uncreditedTranslation: A translation exists, but the translator is uncredited. Is it made by an anonymous contributor?
